name: momentum
description: Root task runner for the Momentum monorepo (ios, backend, web).

scripts.install: bun install --cwd backend && bun install --cwd web
scripts.update: (cd backend && bun update --latest) && (cd web && bun update --latest)
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:web
scripts.lint: bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:web && bun run lint:ios && bunx prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn .
